annual_report.name: None
annual_report.due: Ohio has no LLC annual report

state_tax_on_llc.name: Commercial Activity Tax (CAT)
state_tax_on_llc.applies: businesses (any entity type incl. sole proprietors/LLCs) with Ohio taxable gross receipts over $6 million (calendar 2025 and after)
state_tax_on_llc.notes: Annual minimum tax eliminated from 2024. 0.26% on receipts above $6,000,000; no return required at or below $6M.

sources.title: Ohio SOS Form 610 - Articles of Organization for a Domestic LLC
Ohio DOT CAT Information Release 2023-01
sources.quote: For calendar year 2025 and thereafter, the exclusion amount is increased to $6 million.

entity_level_taxes.name: Commercial Activity Tax (CAT)
entity_level_taxes.notes: Only on Ohio taxable gross receipts above $6 million.

entity_level_taxes.name: Municipal net profit tax
entity_level_taxes.notes: Ohio cities tax S corporation net profits at the entity level at the municipal rate (e.g. 2.5% Columbus). Shareholder distributions are generally not taxed again by the city (not verified per city).

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Electing pass-through entity tax on Form IT 4738; from taxable years beginning 2026 estimated payments due April 15, June 15, September 15, January 15. Composite IT 4708 rate is 3.00% from 2026 (3.125% in 2025); IT 4738 rate for 2026 not confirmed.

sources.title: Ohio DOT CAT Information Release 2023-01
sources.quote: The CAT rate of 0.26% remains unchanged

sources.title: Ohio DOT - PTE OVTA materials Sept 2025 (House Bill 96)
sources.quote: 3.00%: Reporting period starting on or after January 1, 2026

personal_exemption.notes: Exemption $1,900 per person per the 2026 IT 1040ES worksheet (amount varies with income in law; zero if income $500,000 or more). Business income: first $250,000 deductible (single/MFJ), remainder taxed at flat 3% regardless of brackets. Brackets apply to nonbusiness income, same for all filing statuses.

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: None at state level; Ohio school district income taxes and municipal income taxes apply on top.

sources.title: Ohio Revised Code 5747.02 (effective 9-30-2025, HB 96)
sources.quote: $332.00 plus 2.75% of the amount in excess of $26,050 (taxable years beginning in 2026 and later, per search extract)

sources.title: 2026 Ohio Estimated Income Tax Payment Worksheet
sources.quote: Multiply the business income portion of line 5 by 3%

sources.title: Ohio DOT - Annual Tax Rates (lists through 2025)

estimated_tax.required_if: estimated Ohio tax (after credits) less Ohio withholding is more than $500
estimated_tax.notes: Safe harbor: 90% of current-year tax or 100% of prior-year tax. Municipal and school district estimated taxes are separate.

unemployment_2026.notes: Rate year 2026: new (non-construction) employer rate 2.7% plus 0.15% mutualized/surcharge = 2.85% total; construction new employer 5.7%.

local_taxes.name: Municipal income tax (wages and net profits)
local_taxes.applies: residents on all income; nonresidents on income earned in Columbus; business net profits apportioned to Columbus
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: Residents get 100% credit for tax paid to other cities up to 2.5%
local_taxes.quote: Columbus residents pay a total of 2.5% in taxes on all income earned

local_taxes.name: Municipal income tax (CCA)
local_taxes.applies: residents, nonresidents working in Cleveland, business net profits

local_taxes.name: Municipal income tax
local_taxes.applies: residents on all income incl. Schedule C/E/F net profit; nonresidents on Cincinnati-apportioned income
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: Resident credit for tax paid to other cities up to 1.8%
local_taxes.quote: The current Cincinnati income tax rate effective 10/02/20 is 1.8%.

local_taxes.name: Municipal income tax
local_taxes.applies: residents, nonresidents working in Toledo, business net profits
local_taxes.quote: effective January 1, 2021, the city of Toledo income tax rate is two and one-half percent (2.5%).

local_taxes.name: Municipal income tax
local_taxes.applies: residents, nonresidents working in Akron, business net profits (also its JEDDs)
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: Credit for tax paid to other municipalities up to 2.5%

local_taxes.name: Municipal income tax
local_taxes.applies: residents and nonresidents working in Dayton; wages, business income, rental income
local_taxes.threshold_or_exemption: 2.25% base + 0.25% (Ord. 32072-23, Jan 1 2025 - Dec 31 2032); resident credit up to 2.5%
local_taxes.quote: The current tax rate for the City of Dayton is 2.5%

notable: 2026: HB 96 collapses the nonbusiness brackets into one 2.75% rate above $26,050 (https://codes.ohio.gov/assets/laws/revised-code/authenticated/57/5747/5747.02/9-30-2025/5747.02-9-30-2025.pdf)
First $250,000 of business income deductible, rest taxed at flat 3% (https://tax.ohio.gov/individual/file-now/business-income-deduction-information)
No LLC annual report and no franchise tax; CAT only above $6 million of receipts (https://tax.ohio.gov/static/commercial_activities/information_releases/CAT_2023-01_info_release.pdf)
Municipal income taxes (often 2.5%) apply to self-employment net profits; most cities tax net profits of S corps/LLCs at entity level (https://ccatax.ci.cleveland.oh.us/?p=taxrates)
